<main class="wrap">
  <header class="prose">
    <div class="eyebrow">alpha &#183; WBS.md</div>
    
    <h1>alpha: what sets the pace</h1>
    <p>A network of every open leaf that waits on, or is waited on by, another open leaf, then a schedule of all open work across parallel agent lanes. Columns give the earliest slot a leaf can start in, counting one slot per leaf. The red line is the critical path: the chain with no slack.</p>
    
    
    
  </header>

  <div class="work">
  <section>
    <h2>Two limits on the finish date</h2>
    <figure class="limits">
      <svg viewBox="0 0 760 168" role="img" aria-label="The critical chain is 36 to 36 agent-hours; all open work is 84 to 84 agent-hours."><text class="lim-label" x="0" y="30">Critical chain (6 leaves)</text><rect class="bar-crit" x="190" y="16" width="240" height="20"/><rect class="bar-crit span" x="430" y="16" width="0" height="20"/><g data-unestimated="6"><text class="lim-val" x="438" y="31">36–36 h</text><text class="lim-note" x="190" y="52">includes 6 unestimated leaves</text></g><text class="lim-label" x="0" y="94">All 14 scheduled leaves</text><rect class="bar-open" x="190" y="80" width="560" height="20"/><rect class="bar-open span" x="750" y="80" width="0" height="20"/><g data-unestimated="14"><text class="lim-val" x="750" y="118" text-anchor="end">84–84 h</text><text class="lim-note" x="750" y="134" text-anchor="end">includes 14 unestimated leaves</text></g><line class="lim-axis" x1="190" y1="142" x2="750" y2="142"/><text class="lim-note" x="190" y="160">agent-hours; solid to the low estimate, pale to the high one</text></svg>
      <figcaption data-unestimated="14">At 6 agent-hours a day, the critical chain is 6 to 6 working days and all open work is 14 to 14. With one operator, the total sets the finish date. The chain decides order: its first leaf has to start early enough that the chain is not the last thing left. The total includes 14 unestimated leaves.</figcaption>
    </figure>
  </section>

      <div id="hours-note" data-unestimated="6">Weighting each leaf by its hours picks the same chain, 36 h end to end; includes 6 unestimated leaves.</div>
      <div>11 of the 14 open leaves have an open link and appear in the network; the other 3 appear only in the schedule. WBS.md gives 10 links between them; 1 repeat what a longer chain implies and are not drawn.</div>

  <section>
    <div class="prose">
      <h2><span class="anchor" id="leaf-2.6"></span><span class="anchor" id="leaf-Issue-15"></span><span class="anchor" id="leaf-Issue-20"></span>Schedule across agent lanes</h2>
      <p>All open leaves, linked or not, spread across parallel agent lanes. Each lane is one agent session working 6 agent-hours a day, and each leaf takes the midpoint of its estimate, or the default unit when it has none. When a lane comes free it takes the most urgent leaf that is ready; a leaf takes the priority of anything it unblocks, and WBS order breaks ties. This is one plausible plan, not a forecast.</p>
      <p class="label">agent capacity only; ignores operator attention; the week view is the plan</p>
      
      
    </div>
    <div class="controls">
      <label for="g-lanes">Agent lanes</label>
      <select id="g-lanes" data-control="lanes"><option value="1">1</option><option value="2">2</option><option value="3">3</option><option value="4" selected>4</option><option value="5">5</option><option value="6">6</option><option value="7">7</option><option value="8">8</option></select>
      <span class="controls" role="group" aria-label="Group rows by">
        <button type="button" data-control="group" data-value="epic" aria-pressed="true">By epic</button>
        <button type="button" data-control="group" data-value="lane" aria-pressed="false">By lane</button>
      </span>
      <button type="button" data-control="expand" data-value="all">Expand all epics</button>
      <button type="button" data-control="expand" data-value="none">Collapse all</button>

    <p id="g-limit" aria-live="polite"></p>
    <p class="summary" id="g-sum" data-unestimated="14" data-unestimated-chain="6">With 4 lanes, all open work ends around working day 6 and the critical chain around day 6. The chain alone needs 6 days; the work spread evenly across the lanes needs 4. The lanes are busy 58% of the time. The plan includes 14 unestimated leaves (6 on the critical chain).</p>

      <p id="g-dates" class="label" data-unestimated="14">dates include 14 unestimated leaves</p>
